name: Rotech
desc:
Patient Care Customer Service, Evenings & Weekends | $16/hr + Quarterly Bonus | Inbound and Outbound Patient Orders, No Sales Expectations
Company: Rotech Healthcare Inc.
Industry: Health Science

What Your Day Will Look Like:
Rotech provides home medical equipment like oxygen, CPAP machines for sleep apnea, and ventilators. In this role, you work for Sleep Central, Rotech's after-hours call center. You'll talk with patients by phone about their equipment deliveries, take their orders, verify their information, and enter orders into the system on time. You'll type up patient profiles during calls, collect needed medical paperwork, process orders through an online pharmacy system, fix tracking problems, and reschedule shipments. When a patient has an equipment problem, you'll ask questions to figure out what's wrong. Some outbound calls are part of the job.

Soft Skills
- Patience with patients
- Accurate typing during calls
- Problem solving
- Keeping information private
- Working independently on evenings and weekends
assessment: Expect an assessment involving a typing test
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED
Required Experience: None required
Preferred Experience: 1 year of related work, medical field or medical records experience, medical equipment experience, medical billing knowledge, and medical terminology

Required Skills:
- Strong English communication, written and verbal
- Basic math
- Attention to detail and multitasking
- Self-motivated and organized
- Keeps information confidential
- Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Comfortable researching online

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Wants evenings and weekends, like a student or parent with weekday daytime commitments
- Wants a no-experience entry point into healthcare
- Types well while talking on the phone
- Likes solving problems for patients

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Can't work every Saturday and Sunday
- Needs weekday daytime hours
- Can't pass a background check or drug screen if required
- Struggles to keep orders organized and on time
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process. Rotech says hiring managers review resumes and reach out to applicants who match.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Patient order processing
- Home medical equipment
- CPAP and sleep therapy
- Inbound and outbound calls
- Data entry
- Shipping and tracking
- Troubleshooting
- Medical documentation
- HIPAA and confidentiality
- Customer service

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your customer service experience.
- This role requires every Saturday and Sunday plus three weekday evenings. How does that fit your schedule?
- A patient says their CPAP delivery never arrived. What do you do?
- Tell us about a time you solved a problem for a customer over the phone. What happened, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you had to be very accurate with information. What was the task, how did you handle it, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: $16/hr plus a quarterly bonus opportunity.
-Shift: Five days a week: every Saturday and Sunday, plus three weekday evening shifts starting at or after 4:00 p.m. Central. Schedules vary and can be discussed in the interview.
-Benefits: Generous PTO and paid holidays, 401(k), HSA, FSA, medical, prescription, dental, and vision, life and disability insurance, EAP, and mental health and chronic condition programs.
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting. Ask in the interview.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case. Rotech does a background check but says results won't automatically disqualify anyone. They look at the role, the offense, how long ago it was, and evidence of rehabilitation.
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: A no-experience healthcare job with an evening and weekend schedule, which works well for participants who need weekday daytime free. The background policy is friendly to second-chance candidates. Must live in the U.S. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Patient Care Coordinator → Senior Patient Care Coordinator → Insurance Verification or Intake Specialist → Team Lead → Customer Service Supervisor. This role builds home medical equipment, patient order, and healthcare customer service skills.
